nom: fresh Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin says the toner, paired with the matching moisturizer, works well for oily skin with no bad reaction; another reviewer without oily skin herself guesses the formula would suit oily and dry skin types too.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are the most vocal group: several call it one of the few toners that hydrates without the tight, stripped feeling they usually get, one recommends patting on a second layer if skin is very dry, and one reports no breakouts or redness after nearly three months of use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one with an oily T-zone and dry nose and one who describes her skin as oily and acne-prone, say the toner balances things out, hydrating without heaviness or new breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers find it calming and non-irritating despite the rose fragrance; the one dissenting view comes from a reviewer without sensitive skin herself, who guesses the scent would not suit sensitive skin.
segments.mature: The single reviewer who gives her age, in her mid-40s, describes her combination skin as well balanced by the toner, with no tightness or slickness.

concerns.dehydration: Across dry, oily, combination and sensitive skin, reviewers overwhelmingly report the toner hydrates without leaving the face tight, sticky or stripped, and several dry-skin reviewers single it out as one of the few toners that does not worsen dryness; the lone dissenting review still liked the scent but found other, simpler toners worked a little better for her overall.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who mention redness or irritation report it easing: one with acne-prone, combination skin says redness and irritation have calmed since starting it, and another with dry skin reports no redness over nearly three months of use; no reviewer describes new redness caused by the toner.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or oily-combination skin report no new breakouts, including one who describes no bad reaction after switching to it and another who reports none in three months of use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin generally find it absorbs quickly without heaviness or residue; one reviewer without a stated oily skin type is the exception, describing the formula itself as feeling a bit oily and slower to absorb than she would like.
concerns.barrier: Two reviewers credit the toner with supporting the skin barrier: one says her barrier responds well and feels soothed quickly, the other that it helps strengthen the barrier alongside refining pores.
concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers say their skin looks more youthful and plump after use, though neither gives more specific detail such as fine lines or firmness.

Petals can get in the way when pouring
Nice-to-have but pricey and non-essential for some

extraits.texte: I really wanted this toner to be a staple in my routine, but for me it ended up feeling more like an optional extra than something essential. I tried incorporating it regularly, but I found that other toners with more straightforward ingredient lists worked a bit better for my skin. That said, I did enjoy the scent—it's really pleasant and makes the product feel nice to use. I especially liked it for a quick refresh after the gym or in the middle of the day when I wanted something light on my skin. Overall it's a nice product, but I personally didn't find it necessary as a core step in my skincare routine. Received gifted by freshbeauty in exchange for an honest review.

Really nice hydrating toner that leaves my skin soft and glowing. The rose scent is light and pleasant. Only downside is it feels a bit oily and doesn't absorb as quickly as I'd like. Still a good option, especially for dry skin. Gifted by freshbeauty

I use this after using the hydrating facial wash and I love how gentle, yet effective it is for my *melanated* skin. I've been searching for a toner that does not dry my dry skin or burn after use. I have been using for nearly three months and have not experienced any breakouts or redness. I am noticing more of a fresh face glow as time goes on.

I received this complimentary from FreshBeauty. This is such a delicate and very gentle toner on my acne prone and combination skin. Ever since I have started to use this I have noticed that irritation and redness in my skin has calmed and is definitely starting to be less now. The rose in this I feel is the most perfect ingredient to have during my skincare routine. I love applying two to three drops to my face and I feel like that is sufficient enough to be able to drench my face with this amazing product. Overall I am definitely going to continue to use this as I am enjoying the results this is giving me

I have really dry skin, so I'm always careful with toners — a lot of them just leave my skin feeling tight. This one is different. The texture is lightweight but slightly silky, not watery, and it feels really nice to apply. I usually press it into my skin with my hands, and it instantly feels more hydrated and calm. After using it consistently, my skin looks softer, more balanced, and naturally glowy. It's a really gentle, hydrating toner that actually makes a difference for dry skin. gifted by freshbeauty

gifted by freshbeauty. As someone with sensitive skin this toner is great for my skin and doesn't irritate it. It can be applied with a cotton round or with your hands. It has become one of my favorite toners and I love that rose petals are in the bottle. It adds a nice aesthetically pleasing touch to the product. The toner leaves my skin hydrated and plump. It layers well with the rest of my skincare routine and under makeup.

My skin is a combination of oily and acne prone. This product leaves a fabulous glow each time I put it on my skin. It also feels very refreshing when I put it on my skin. My skin didn't react badly to this product, I will be sticking to this for a while! The toner and the rose moisturizer is the best combination for oily skin girlies! Gifted by freshbeauty
